lines.t:
An <c:ffff00>act<c> that builds up the force hidden within the
<c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c> without using <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c>. There is no <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> or
<c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c>: it stays in a <c:ffff00>charging stance<c> for a set
time, during which it can <c:ffff00>defend<c> but can't <c:ffff00>evade<c>.

The <c:ffff00>{{charge_gauge}}<c> rises little by little and, on
completion, by a fixed amount more. The time of
each charge and the amount of force added depend
on the <c:ffff00>{{charge_type}}<c> set for each {{medal}}.
